title: Why AI Compute Comes in Rectangles — Erik Bernhardsson, Modal CEO
author: Latent.Space
description: Elastic GPUs, sandbox growth, and the economics of the agent cloud
summary: Warm welcome to Basil Chatha , our newest cohost from the Forward Deployed side of the AI Engineering world! We’ll be ramping up a new show with him and couldn’t pass up an interview with Modal’s CEO Eric on the occasion of their monster Series D!
takeaways: In our recent interview with Akshat , we explored this shift from developer experience to agent experience; here Erik adds the product and business story.

Jump to the GPU price discussion → The sandbox that almost didn’t make it Modal launched sandboxes after Erik and cofounder Akshat Bubna noticed that language models could generate code—and that someone would need a place to run it.
Then coding agents, background agents, and reinforcement learning created new demand.
